name: Sarah Mitchell
tagline: Detail-focused, warm and always happy around pets.
bio: Sarah brings meticulous attention to detail and a warm approach to every home she cleans. She enjoys helping clients feel comfortable and confident in their space.

name: Marco Rossi
tagline: Friendly, reliable and especially at home in the kitchen.
bio: Marco combines a friendly attitude with a consistent and careful approach to every job. He enjoys creating clean, organised spaces and is especially confident with kitchens and high-use areas.

name: Priya Sharma
tagline: Experienced, organised and committed to making every clean feel effortless.
bio: Priya brings years of experience and a calm, organised approach to every service. As a Team Lead, she supports both clients and cleaners while making sure each job is completed to a high standard.

name: James Cooper
tagline: Positive, thorough and always ready to tackle a challenging clean.
bio: James is known for his positive energy and thorough approach to every cleaning task. He enjoys taking on demanding jobs and making sure clients can see a clear difference when the work is finished.

name: Emma Williams
tagline: Detail-driven, dependable and focused on making every space guest-ready.
bio: Emma has strong experience with Airbnb turnovers and detailed residential cleaning. She enjoys creating fresh, welcoming spaces and works carefully to make sure every room is ready for the next guest or family.
